description: Symbol Convergence Fixes: Lock proven symbols, gate new entries, throttle discovery, liquidate experimental first, belt-and-suspenders filtering

part_6.name: Config Parameters
part_6.changes: Added 6 convergence config params (SYMBOL_CONVERGENCE_MODE, PROVEN_SYMBOLS, EXCLUDED_SYMBOLS, convergence limits)

part_7.name: SharedState Convergence Infrastructure
part_7.changes: Added tracking dicts + 6 convergence methods (is_symbol_excluded, is_symbol_proven, add_to_exclusion_list, get_experimental_symbols, get_experimental_count, can_add_new_symbol)

part_8.name: SymbolScreener Early Gating
part_8.changes: Added 3 gating methods (_should_accept_symbol, _is_proven_symbol, _get_experimental_count) + modified _propose() to gate BEFORE symbol_proposals write
part_8.note: Early filter - prevents bad symbols from entering proposals

part_9.name: SwingTradeHunter Capital Allocation
part_9.changes: Added get_available_capital_for_symbol() method: 80% to proven (divide by 7), 20% to experimental (divide by max 2)
part_9.note: Enforces capital discipline - prevents over-leveraging experimental symbols

part_q1_integration.name: LiquidationAgent Healing Prioritization
part_q1_integration.changes: Modified build_plan() sorting: liquidate experimental symbols FIRST (before proven) during healing liquidations
part_q1_integration.note: Q1 Answer A: Liquidate experimental symbols with priority (higher risk first)

part_q5_integration.name: UURE Second Gating Check (Belt-and-Suspenders)
part_q5_integration.changes: Added convergence gate check in _collect_discovery_proposals() BEFORE adding to discovery_syms
part_q5_integration.note: Late filter - double-protection against symbol churn (early filter in SymbolScreener, late filter here)

user_q_and_a_decisions.Q1_healing_priority: A - Experimental symbols liquidated FIRST (implemented in LiquidationAgent)
user_q_and_a_decisions.Q2_replacement: B - Allow experimental symbol replacement (existing logic OK, no changes needed)
user_q_and_a_decisions.Q3_experimental_count: A - Count ALL experimental toward limit (implemented in get_experimental_count)
user_q_and_a_decisions.Q4_capital_allocation: B - Static 20% healing budget (FIX8_HEALING_ALLOCATION_PCT = 0.20, no dynamic allocation)
user_q_and_a_decisions.Q5_gating_strategy: C - Gate in BOTH places: belt-and-suspenders (SymbolScreener early + UURE late)

expected_impact.symbol_count: Reduce from 43 all-time to 7-9 active symbols
expected_impact.capital_efficiency: Enforce 60/20/20 allocation: proven symbols prioritized for compounding, experimental restricted to healing pool
expected_impact.risk_reduction: Eliminate 22 one-time failed symbols from trading pool

next_steps: 2. Verify all 10 fixes in place: Parts 1-5 (healing) + Parts 6-10 (convergence)
3. System restart to activate all fixes
5. Confirm symbol count stabilizes and P&L trend positive
